tasks.label: Deploy Hub to Heroku
tasks.command: git subtree push --prefix hub heroku main

tasks.label: Hub: Edit development credentials
tasks.detail: bin/rails credentials:edit --environment development: opens in a tab, saved encrypted when the tab is closed (needs config/credentials/development.key)

tasks.label: Hub: Edit production credentials
tasks.detail: bin/rails credentials:edit --environment production: opens in a tab, saved encrypted when the tab is closed (needs config/credentials/production.key)

tasks.label: Release: rig-agent and/or processing
tasks.detail: docs/RELEASING.md: bump the version, uv lock, test, commit, push, then tag and push the tag (asks before pushing)
tasks.command: case '${input:releaseComponent}' in both) tools/release.sh rig-agent && tools/release.sh processing ;; *) tools/release.sh '${input:releaseComponent}' ;; esac

tasks.label: Release: test build (no release)
tasks.detail: docs/RELEASING.md step 2: runs the release workflow on main by hand; the executable ends up as a run artifact
tasks.command: case '${input:releaseComponent}' in both) set -- rig-agent processing ;; *) set -- '${input:releaseComponent}' ;; esac; for c; do gh workflow run release-$c.yml --ref main || exit 1; done; sleep 5; gh run watch
